has announced a proposed private offering of $3.0B aggregate principal amount of convertible senior notes due 2033, with an initial purchaser option to purchase up to an additional $500 million aggregate principal amount of notes.
The company said the offering is subject to market and other conditions and that the interest rate, initial conversion rate and other terms will be determined at pricing.

The Notes will be jointly and severally, fully and unconditionally guaranteed by CoreWeave’s wholly owned subsidiaries that guarantee its existing series of senior notes and convertible notes, and will accrue interest payable in cash semi-annually in arrears.
CoreWeave said the notes and subsidiary guarantees will be general senior, unsecured obligations of CoreWeave and the guarantors.
Noteholders will have the right to convert in cash, shares of Class A common stock, or a combination of cash and shares at its election.
CoreWeave stated it intends to use a portion of the net proceeds to fund capped call transactions and to use the remainder for general corporate purposes.

In connection with pricing, CoreWeave expects to enter into privately negotiated capped call transactions with the initial purchasers or their affiliates and/or other financial institutions (the option counterparties).
The Notes will mature on April 1, 2033.
, the company has $27.56B long term debt and $7.51B short term debt.

title: CoreWeave files for $3.0B convertible notes offering with up to $500 million option
